tagline: Strengthening connections between financial institutions and their customers through innovative technology
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the Hero because it represents the company's primary revenue source (57% of total revenue) and grows steadily at 6.7% year-over-year, demonstrating the stability of the recurring business model based on cloud services and customer support.

kpis.name: Services and Support Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from cloud services, customer support, and product delivery services
kpis.description: Includes private/public cloud revenue, product delivery services, and on-premise support
kpis.signal: Growth in services and support revenue

kpis.name: Processing Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from payment processing, card transactions, and digital services
kpis.description: Includes interchange revenue, credit card fees, and digital and transaction revenue
kpis.signal: Growth in payment and digital processing revenue

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue combining services, support, and payment processing
kpis.description: Sum of services and support revenue (57%) and processing revenue (43%)

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total operating expenses including cost of revenue, R&D, and sales/administration
kpis.description: Includes cost of revenue (1360.747M), R&D (162.771M), and SG&A (283.055M)

kpis.name: Cost of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Direct costs associated with generating service and processing revenue
kpis.description: Direct costs decreasing as a percentage of total revenue (57% in 2025 vs 59% in 2024)

kpis.name: Services and Support Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from cloud services, customer support, and product delivery services
kpis.description: Including private/public cloud (6-year contracts), product delivery services, and on-premise support
kpis.signal: Stable growth in recurring cloud and support revenue

kpis.name: Processing Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from payment processing, card transactions, and digital transactions
kpis.description: Including interchange, card processing with extended fraud services, and digital transactions
kpis.signal: Acceleration in payment and digital revenue growth

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.456 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $0.569 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $6.24 in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Data security breaches
risks.score_rationale: The company receives, processes, and stores sensitive information. A security breach could compromise customer data, intellectual property, and severely damage reputation and operations (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Operational failures and service interruptions
risks.score_rationale: Failures in computer systems or third parties could disrupt critical services provided to 7,400 financial clients (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Increased competition in the fintech market
risks.score_rationale: The financial technology solutions market is competitive, with potential pressures on pricing and market share (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Dependence on third-party vendors
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on third parties for certain operations and technology components, creating risks of external failures (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Reputational and customer trust risks
risks.score_rationale: As a critical provider to 7,400 financial institutions, JKHY's reputation is essential. Any major incident could lead to significant customer losses (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: As a critical service provider to the financial sector, JKHY is subject to strict regulatory requirements (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

ai_positioning.summary: The company JKHY has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts. Its business focuses on traditional financial technology solutions for banks and credit unions.
